description: Most Langerhans cells arise before birth and renew themselves in the epidermis. When inflammation or ultraviolet light empties it, blood monocytes settle in the epidermis and become Langerhans cells: in mice, a first, short-lived wave from Gr-1-high monocytes is followed by cells from steady-state bone marrow precursors. TGF-β1 is needed for Langerhans cell development. In people, donor blood cells refilled the epidermis after a bone marrow transplant.
